state.seed_assertion: To determine whether processing is on a large scale, one should consider the number of individuals concerned, volume of data, variety of data, duration of processing, and geographical extent.

sentences.1: To determine whether processing is on a large scale, one should consider the number of individuals concerned, volume of data, variety of data, duration of processing, and geographical extent.
sentences.2: to decide whether processing is on a large scale you should consider: the number of individuals concerned;
sentences.6: and the geographical extent of the processing.
sentences.7: Large-scale processing should be assessed by considering the number of individuals, volume of data, variety of data, duration of processing, and geographical extent.
sentences.8: The scope of processing should include details about the nature, volume, variety, sensitivity, extent, frequency, duration of processing, number of data subjects, and geographical area covered.
sentences.9: Organizations must always conduct a DPIA if they plan to process special-category data or criminal-offence data on a large scale.
sentences.10: Large-scale systematic monitoring of publicly accessible areas automatically requires a DPIA under Article 35(3).
sentences.11: Large-scale profiling of individuals requires a DPIA.
sentences.12: Any profiling of individuals on a large scale
